dialogues.jp: 「しっかし、今日のＨＲは無駄だよな」
dialogues.en: "Homeroom today was a waste of time."
dialogues.text: "Homeroom today was a waste of time."

dialogues.jp:
卒パの準備があるヤツはともかく、参加しない
ヤツにとっては、ＨＲのためだけに来たような
もんだもんな。
dialogues.en:
It's one thing if you're participating in the graduation
party, but for those not participating, it was a waste of
time.
dialogues.text:
It's one thing if you're participating in the graduation
party, but for those not participating, it was a waste of
time.

dialogues.jp: 合理的じゃないよな。
dialogues.en: It's not very practical.
dialogues.text: It's not very practical.

dialogues.jp:
（どうして行事ってのはこう、やたらと無駄が
　多いんだ？）
dialogues.en: (These events are such a waste of time!)
dialogues.text: (These events are such a waste of time!)

dialogues.jp:
まあ、でもこれで事実上、春休みみたいなもん
だからな。
dialogues.en: Well, we're practically on spring break now.
dialogues.text: Well, we're practically on spring break now.

dialogues.jp: （よく遊び、よく食べ、よく寝る生活を送ろう）
dialogues.en: (I'm going to play a lot, eat a lot, and sleep a lot.)
dialogues.text: (I'm going to play a lot, eat a lot, and sleep a lot.)

dialogues.jp: 「まずは“よく遊ぶ”からだな」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to start with playing a lot first."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to start with playing a lot first."

dialogues.jp: 付属の１階に下り、昇降口に向かう。
dialogues.en: I went down the stairs and headed toward the exit.
dialogues.text: I went down the stairs and headed toward the exit.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、萌先輩」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
階段を下りて角を曲がったところで、萌先輩と
出くわす。
dialogues.en:
I bumped into Moe-sempai when I turned the corner of the
stairway.
dialogues.text:
I bumped into Moe-sempai when I turned the corner of the
stairway.

dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんです？　もしかして、眞子に会い
　に行くところですか？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing? Are you going to see Mako?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing? Are you going to see Mako?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……眞子ちゃんはまだ教室にいたでしょ
　うか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... was Mako-chan still in her classroom?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... was Mako-chan still in her classroom?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、俺が教室を出たときはまだいたかな」
dialogues.en: "Umm, I think she was still there when I left the room."
dialogues.text: "Umm, I think she was still there when I left the room."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Really? Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Really? Thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩は卒パに参加するんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going to participate in the graduation party?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going to participate in the graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。音楽部のほうで参加します」
dialogues.en: "Yes. We're participating with the music club."
dialogues.text: "Yes. We're participating with the music club."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんは？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going to participate, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going to participate, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。俺は帰宅組です」
dialogues.en: "No. I'm going home now."
dialogues.text: "No. I'm going home now."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、鞄を見せる。
dialogues.en: I spoke and showed her my bag.
dialogues.text: I spoke and showed her my bag.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You are?"
dialogues.text: "You are?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: なにも参加自由の行事に特攻することもない。
dialogues.en: I don't need to participate in an elective event.
dialogues.text: I don't need to participate in an elective event.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺はこの辺で。先輩も準備頑張って」
dialogues.en: "I should go now. Good luck with your practice."
dialogues.text: "I should go now. Good luck with your practice."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
互いにすれ違って、萌先輩は階段を上っていく。
俺もざわつく廊下を歩き昇降口へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
We passed each other and Moe-sempai went up the stairs. I
walked through the crowded hallway toward the exit.
dialogues.text:
We passed each other and Moe-sempai went up the stairs. I
walked through the crowded hallway toward the exit.

dialogues.jp: 「まずはゲーセンかな……」
dialogues.en: "I'll going to the arcade first......"
dialogues.text: "I'll going to the arcade first......"

dialogues.jp: 靴を履き替えつつ財布の中身を確認する。
dialogues.en: I changed my shoes and checked inside of my wallet.
dialogues.text: I changed my shoes and checked inside of my wallet.

dialogues.jp:
今日はどんなゲームも物量で押し切れるだけの
｛きんがく／兵力｝を持ってきていた。
dialogues.en:
I brought enough money to defeat my enemies and win the
game.
dialogues.text:
I brought enough money to defeat my enemies and win the
game.

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩は音楽部で参加◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai's participating in the party◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai's participating in the party◆

dialogues.jp:
帰り道、萌先輩と出会った。眞子を迎えに来た
のだ。
dialogues.en: I saw Moe-sempai on my way back home. She came to get Mako.
dialogues.text: I saw Moe-sempai on my way back home. She came to get Mako.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は、音楽部で卒パに参加するとの事だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai's going to participate in the graduation party as
a member of a music club.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai's going to participate in the graduation party as
a member of a music club.
